description: This file defines a PHP class `MarketplaceDeploymentClient` that extends `AwsClient` to interact with the AWS Marketplace Deployment Service. It includes method annotations for operations like listing, tagging, and untagging resources, both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: MarketplaceDeploymentClient
classes.description: A client class used to communicate with the AWS Marketplace Deployment Service API, providing methods for resource tagging, deployment parameter management, and other service interactions.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Retrieves tags associated with a specified resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves tags associated with a specified resource.

methods.name: putDeploymentParameter
methods.description: Sets a deployment parameter for the marketplace deployment.

methods.name: putDeploymentParameterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sets a deployment parameter for the marketplace deployment.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Associates tags with a specified resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates tags with a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a specified resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

calls:
GuzzleHttp	oPromise
ew Promise (for async methods)
